beats: Working a list of leads meant bouncing between a map popup and a tab to see one lead's contacts or next step.
Now a 'Client' tab is the default view — one big card holds the whole picture.
J and K jump to the next or previous lead on the Leaflet map, no back and forth.
A background scan, no longer blocked by a quota pause, pulls in real photos.
One card, two keys, up to 16 photos per lead.
